rows.en: Baio: "That miserly raccoon Growster, buying nothing but Daga...!
He balks at a mere twelve-billion-mil
He doesn't even understand that it's cheap
for what it can do! Don't you agree, Melissa?"
Melissa: "Yes, Doctor... But 'miserly raccoon' is too much."
Baio: "I don't care! Anyone who puts my Bine Daga
in the same category as mere Spirit Mechs
Baio: "Don't worry. You've been testing Bine Daga
Baio: "Spirit Mechs... Why that name...? Could it be..."
Touya: "Phew. Is that all of it? ...Hmm?"
Yamato: "Come on, don't stop working... What's wrong?"
Yamato: "It is. We're taking Rayblade along too..."
Ymir: "It would be more dangerous to leave it here,
so Lady Ivel told us to bring it."
Yamato: "True. Once the Spirit Mechs leave,
someone might try to take Rayblade."

Touya: "I see. After all that...? That scent..."
Ymir: "Oh, this? Lady Ivel gave it to me.

Bernst: "Oh, this scent... Lacrima, isn't it?"
Ymir: "Huh? Oh, yes. She said it was extracted
from a flower with a name like that."
Touya: "You know about this stuff too?"
Lacrima was a flower an old acquaintance loved."
Bernst: "By the way, the one who discovered Rayblade
So that's how it was. Heh heh heh..."
Ymir: "Well, shall we go to the bridge?"
Maki: "I'm in! Heh heh... The next Roguewar Prize
is as good as mine. Just watch... I'll expose Rayblade's
Kasumi: "So this is a Spirit Mech...
Ai: "Just Ai. We're going to be friends,
so we need to break down these 'walls' at the start.
Otherwise, things will just drag on.
Besides, I don't like formal speech."
Ai: "There, see? It feels distant, doesn't it?
As long as you respect someone,
I think that's enough, even without showing it in words.
There's no need to fuss over formalities.
What matters is the attitude in your heart, right?"
From today on, you can call me 'Ai-chan.'
Can I call you Kasumi in return?"
Ai: "Heh heh... Ha ha ha ha!"
because I didn't seem very welcome... But I'm glad
there's someone like you who'll talk to me..."
Well, Touya-chan is different. He talks rough,
but he's always defended me. He's so kind."
...So, honestly, how far along are you two?"
Ai: "No way... Y-You're already that far?!
You seem quiet, but you've certainly made your moves..."
It's not like that... We've only kissed..."
Ai: "What?! A kiss?! I was only joking..."
Kasumi: "Huh?! Oh, b-but that was an accident...
Ai: "Oh, s-sorry! Geez! Don't look at me
with those eyes! Fine! You don't seem the type to lie, Kasumi.
Y-You know, childhood-friend couples are the usual pattern.
Kasumi: "Isn't that in manga and things...?"
Anyway... Isn't it about time to leave?
are the absolute basics in manga and things.
I wondered how it worked in real life."
to have any special feelings, though..."
Ai: "Maybe that's not true. His face changed
when he heard you were the missing person, Kasumi."
Ai: "What would I get out of lying about it?
Though he'd probably do the same for anyone..."
Ai: "Oh, no, no! I'm sure you're special to him, Kasumi. Yeah."
He'd do everything he could to help someone else too.
Mechanic A: "All right! We just have the spare parts left."
Mechanic D: "What's wrong? Did you forget
to say goodbye to your girlfriend?"
Mechanic F: "Maybe I'll come along too."
Mechanic A: "Stop chatting and get to work!
We're leaving soon! Hurry and load that thing too!"
Mechanic B: "Okay! Let's get this done fast!"
Mechanic C: "But... Are we really allowed?"
Mechanic A: "You don't mind parting with Lady Celica like this?"
I'd be a traitor or anything else for her!"
Mechanic A: "No, I didn't go that far..."
Ivel: "Yes. Those who've inherited our wishes and Queen Alforina's
Lodis: "Then let's do what we can."
Oh, that reminds me. This is from that girl."
I've decided to go after all.
and we need countermeasures for ≪Ze=Ode≫'s field.
Besides, I want to see how far my Spirit Mechs
can go with my own eyes.
I'll leave the rest to you.
Lodis: "Sigh... How am I going to report this
Ivel: "I'll do what I can to help cover for you."
I-I'm a thinker... This sort of work..."
Ymir: "What's wrong? What's that huge bag...?"
It contains my most private possessions.
It's dangerous to touch them, so don't come near."
Derock: "Phew... I'll take a short break...
It sounded like it came from the bag..."
Touya: "Ymir! Get that bag while I hold him!"
Celica: "But I'd be bored back at the palace...
And without me, the Spirit Mechs' chief designer,
Touya: "Does Lodis know about... Of course he doesn't..."
I'll report to His Highness later."
Ymir: "But you'll give him a proper explanation yourself, understood?"
We're heading for the Krondem mine ruins,
where a hidden fort has been built.
There we'll join the York forces, then divide into a diversionary force
and an assault force, bound for Flamuelk Castle.
The diversionary force's advance will put Zigrim's troops on alert.
Ideally, they'll come out to ambush it.
If they don't move, we'll shell them a little, then withdraw.
The assault force will occupy the castle when they give chase."
They won't expect a frontal assault from us,
so Reduce and I will act as they expect,
creating a diversion that resembles guerrilla warfare."
Ciel: "I'll accompany you in the assault force."
Arthur: "It would be good if they fell for the diversion,
but surely protecting the castle is their priority.
But it's hard to imagine Zigrim's temperament
allowing them to take it lying down.
They aren't blindly reckless, but they consider it honorable
Celica: "They are called the 'Wild Valor of the West,' after all."
Xiujian: "That's easier to deal with than a country
that abandons an ally out of pragmatism."
Celica: "That stings. Even if I didn't know,
it ended up looking like I'd approved it.
But that's why I want to put that mistake right,
acting on my own wishes this time.
Celica: "No. But it does hurt a little."
Xiujian: "I didn't mean to blame you.
I only wanted to hear what was in your heart.
We'll be fighting together, after all."
Xiujian: "From now on, I won't doubt my comrades."
is to retake Flamuelk Castle, York's symbol.
Maki: "Reisuke, can't you deal with an electromagnetic lock like this in a flash...?"
Maki: "...Of course not... What am I going to do...?
I can't believe I got myself locked in..."
But are you really sure this is all right?"
Garyud: "There's no problem. This was once a planned site
Miyasco: "Oh, look! The mountain... It's splitting open!"
Yamato: "It is. It looks like a secret base.
But the design really stands out."
Reduce: "...I opposed it, but Lord Garyud
Garyud: "Hmm. Seeing it like this, perhaps it was
a little flashy. Still, it looks better than building a lake
and having it emerge from there."
Ciel: "There was a plan like that too?!"
Ymir: "Um... Should we land over there?"
York Soldier B: "Lord Garyud has returned..."
York Soldier C: "We're safe now. Lord Reduce is here,
and Lady Ciel too! We can win!"
York Soldier D: "Yes! And the Spirit Mechs are helping us.
Garyud: "...Forgive me for keeping you waiting.
My carelessness and arrogance brought this upon us.
I'll accept any blame for it.
But first, there's something I must do.
We must free Her Majesty's land, our land,
For the day when we turn yesterday's humiliation
York Soldier G: "Welcome home, Lord Garyud!"
???: "It would be no exaggeration to call Lord Garyud
???: "Ha ha ha! You're as bad at flattery as ever.
Has it been twenty years since you retired?"
I'm still on active duty, you know.
I'm glad we can stand side by side again."
Miyasco: "A-Another person who can talk to the captain..."
Sisk: "The captain was a York soldier, wasn't he?
That might explain how they can converse."
Reduce: "Lord Garna, forgive me for interrupting.
I'd like to discuss what we do next."
This is no time to reminisce at leisure.
Our opponent is Grad Burgley, after all..."
Garna: "...That was fast... Could they have found us?"
